prefix_removal.method: Fresh child process per version/case/repetition; serial alternating AB/BA and reversed case order. One cold and one identical warm request. Startup separate. All werewolf modules preloaded before evaluation. System busy minus worker CPU estimates background; >10% flagged and separate low-background subset reported, never silently dropped. Timeouts/Pending are censored. Diagnostics separate.
prefix_removal.window_method: Raw worker file mtime minus subprocess wall, approximate interval.

Timeouts/Pending are censored. Diagnostics separate.
